events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the enduring legacy of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away in 1996.

angles.name: Music & Impact
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years since his passing, Tupac's music still resonates. What's your go-to track for a dose of his powerful lyricism?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Legacy Lives On
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who left us in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix: a true icon whose guitar work changed music forever. What's the one riff that instantly makes you think of him?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that famous zebra crossing cover, was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'! That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history. Did you know it was shot just outside the studio?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, born today in 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Chrissie Hynde, the voice and force behind The Pretenders, still rocking strong. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the 54th birthday of the legendary frontman, Liam Gallagher, born today in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Liam Gallagher, forever a rock 'n' roll star. What's the Oasis or solo track that always gets you singing along?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless and poignant album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971 in the US.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: 25 Years of the iPod
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the first iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, a little white device changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto your first one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day. Which Bond actor is your ultimate 007, and what's your favourite theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the indelible mark John Lennon left on music and the world. Which of his songs inspires you most?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born today in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite moment from this comedy genius?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' eclectic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of The White Album! So many tracks, so many styles. If you had to pick just one song from it, which would it be?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul' album, a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution, was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Evolution of Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! This album marked a significant shift for The Beatles. What's your favourite track from this influential record?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this solemn day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's his most meaningful song to you?
